implementation_log.summary: pydantic-settings config loaded from TOML (config/sbr.toml, SBR_CONFIG override) with SBR_<SECTION>__<KEY> environment overrides that are validated. Enforced: read-only source roots (read_only=false rejected); no overlap between sources and var/curation/vault; protected paths (D:\studium_duplicated) can be neither a source root nor a writable root; 'restricted' is rejected for every model role; unknown keys and relative paths rejected; every validation problem listed with its location. The vault stays unset (Q-B02) and role primaries stay unset (Q-B04). Stable config_hash for the run ledger.

SourceFS is the only source-access module: stat, iter_dir (never follows links, reports junctions and reparse points, records per-entry errors without paths), open_binary and read_bytes (os.open with O_RDONLY|O_BINARY|O_NOINHERIT; the returned object refuses writes). (root_id, relpath) addressing refuses '..', drive or absolute components, NUL and ':' (ADS). Extended-length \\?\ paths handle long names and trailing dots or spaces. The real path must stay inside the root and outside protected paths (junction escapes refused). Original display path kept for provenance. SourceWriteGuard (runtime) patches os/shutil/open/io.open/os.open mutators and refuses and records any target under source or protected roots. assert_writable() is the check for all future writers. The static AST scan has a reviewed allow-list (sourcefs.py, safety.py).

implementation_log.summary: registry.sqlite in var/db (path checked against protected roots before anything is created). Connections use WAL, synchronous=NORMAL, foreign_keys=ON and a busy timeout, in autocommit mode with explicit BEGIN IMMEDIATE transactions (single-writer discipline). Numbered migrations (migrations/registry/NNNN_name.sql plus .down.sql) with contiguity checks. schema_version stores SHA-256 checksums over CRLF-normalized text, so edited or unknown applied migrations are refused. Each migration applies in one transaction with foreign_key_check before COMMIT and rolls back on failure. The SQLite online-backup copy goes to var/backups/registry before any change to an existing DB; downgrades are supported. 0001_registry: STRICT tables for activity plus all docs/31 tables, CHECK constraints mirroring the model invariants, FKs from every derived row to activity, and a partial unique index (one present observation per path). Generic typed Repository (insert, upsert, get, find, count; no delete) that validates on write and on read and checks that model fields exist as columns.
implementation_log.verification: TS-MIG: fresh to head; every N-1 (1..head) to head with a synthetic next migration (data retained; backup exists and holds version N-1 with data); failing and FK-violating migrations roll back to N-1; downgrade to 0 and re-upgrade; tamper, CRLF and newer-DB checks. Repository round-trip, upsert, FK/CHECK/UNIQUE enforcement, transaction rollback. tests 122 passed; tools/check.ps1 CHECK GREEN

implementation_log.summary: Migration 0002_provenance: derived_from table (entity to source entity, role, optional Locator JSON, activity_id); triggers so that every insert or update of scan, blob, path_observation, archive_member, blob_classification, blob_relation, change_event and derived_from requires an existing RUNNING activity (enforced even for raw SQL); activities must be inserted as running and finish once; finished activities and identity columns are immutable; activities and links are never deleted. ProvenanceStore API: start_activity and finish_activity (params_hash per NFR-04), an activity() context manager (succeeded, failed or cancelled; notes keep only the exception class so no paths leak), link(), record_derived() (entity plus >=1 derived_from atomically; refuses empty or mismatched links), derived_from(), and the integrity queries pv1_violations(table, id) and unresolved_locators() for sbr doctor. transaction() nests via SAVEPOINTs. Knowledge-entity tables (P4/P5) register with pv1_violations when they arrive.
implementation_log.verification: TS-PROV-1: writes to all 7 provenance-bearing tables plus derived_from refused for finished and unknown activities; TS-PROV-2: PV-1 violations (no link or unknown activity) and dangling locators reported; atomic rollback of entity plus links, including under an outer transaction; the 0001 to 0002 upgrade is covered by the generic N-1 migration test; tests 130 passed; tools/check.ps1 CHECK GREEN

implementation_log.summary: Migration 0003_runs: run table (run_id, command path only (no arguments, which may contain paths), config_hash, code_version, git_sha with a +dirty flag, pid, times, status running/succeeded/failed/interrupted, exit_code, error_class, counts JSON); runs are never deleted and finished runs are immutable; a trigger makes activity.run_id reference a recorded run. RunRecord schema (exported). RunLedger plus run_scope(): records the run, sets the run_id contextvar, and finishes as succeeded, failed (error class only), interrupted (KeyboardInterrupt) or by SystemExit code. cli/runtime.command_runtime() gives every stateful CLI command config, a migrated registry, logging and exactly one run row; --help and version stay stateless. JSONL logging: one object per line (ts, level, logger, msg, run_id, stage, subject_id, extra fields), size rotation from the config, RedactionFilter hashing sensitive keys (path, relpath, text, content, ...) and cutting any source-root or protected path (either separator, any case, extended-length form) out of messages and tracebacks; the log dir is checked against protected roots.
implementation_log.verification: 3 CLI invocations produced 3 correct run rows (succeeded / failed ValueError / exit 2); logs parse as JSONL with a single run_id per run; secret names, grades and paths absent from the log file including tracebacks; rotation produced .1 files, all valid JSONL; run delete/update and unknown activity.run_id refused; tests 138 passed; tools/check.ps1 CHECK GREEN

implementation_log.summary: src/sbr/jobs package: JobQueue over the existing work_item/work_output tables (migration 0004, already committed). enqueue() is idempotent on the (subject_id, stage, stage_version) unique key, so a re-run or a restarted pipeline never creates a duplicate row; bumping stage_version inserts a new row and leaves other subjects' rows untouched (exactly-affected re-enqueue). lease() atomically claims pending-and-due items or leased items whose lease has expired (a crashed worker's items) ordered by priority then age; an expired lease that already exhausted max_attempts is retired straight to 'failed' instead of being re-leased, so a crashed worker can never keep a poison item cycling. extend()/complete()/fail() all require the current lease_token, so a re-leased item's original (crashed) holder can never complete or fail it a second time. complete() writes the work_output artifact manifest and the work_item state transition in one SQLite transaction (atomic completion). fail() applies exponential backoff (1s, 2s, 4s, ... capped at 15min) below max_attempts, else terminal 'failed'. jobs/dag.py: ready_stages() plus JobQueue.advance() enqueue exactly the downstream stages of a static stage DAG whose prerequisites are done at their current version (stage DAG enqueueing), idempotently. Schemas: WorkItem/WorkItemState/WorkOutput in schemas/operations.py (JobId/ManifestId in schemas/base.py), registered in db/registry.py as WORK_ITEM/WORK_OUTPUT TableSpecs, exported to schemas/WorkItem.json and schemas/WorkOutput.json.
implementation_log.verification: TS-QUEUE crash-resume test with an injectable millisecond clock (no real sleep, no subprocess): worker A leases an item and is never called again (simulated kill); a fresh JobQueue instance (worker B, as a restarted process would open) cannot claim it before the lease expires, claims it exactly once after, and worker A's stale lease_token can no longer complete it. Stage-version bump re-enqueues only the affected subject (the other subject's row is untouched). Backoff schedule and the max-attempts terminal transition verified; poison items confirmed never returned by lease() again, including via the expired-lease-reap path. Stage DAG advance() verified idempotent and correctly gated on prerequisite completion at the right version. 12/12 new tests passed; full suite 146 passed, 3 pre-existing Windows-only sourcefs/runtime-guard failures (this container is Linux, not Windows/WSL, so a `Regelungstechnik\\skript.pdf`-style os_path literal never resolves here; unrelated to this task, present before it). ruff and mypy clean on every file touched (both had pre-existing, unrelated debt in tools/validate_plan.py and tools/audit_crossrefs.py, and one pre-existing unused-ignore in tests/test_schemas.py:220 predating this session). tools/export_schemas.py --check clean. tools/validate_plan.py: PLAN CONSISTENT. tools/audit_crossrefs.py: CROSSREFS CLEAN.
